en.basel-kadem: 1.	My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, from Ya’qoub bin Yazid, from Ubaid ibn Hilal, that he said: I heard Abu’l-Hasan al-Rida, peace be upon him, say:
Indeed, I love for the believer to be a teller. He said: I said: And what thing is a teller? He said: An clarifier.
